nodes.name: SIMS CSAT webhook
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential, SEPARATE from the inbound 'SIMS Webhook Secret' the four Respond.io workflows use: name 'x-sims-webhook-secret', value = RESPONDIO_CSAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET in SIMS. Do not reuse the inbound credential — rotating that one from SIMS has a grace window that does not apply here, so a shared value makes CSAT sends fail silently until the env var is updated too. Copy this node's production URL into RESPONDIO_CSAT_WEBHOOK_URL.

nodes.name: Validate SIMS payload
nodes.notes: Reads $json.body ?? $json so it works whether or not the webhook node is set to return the raw body. Throws on a payload that is missing the contact id or the message, so a bad call fails visibly instead of sending nothing.

nodes.name: Send CSAT link
nodes.notes: Channel Type is 'Last Interacted Channel' on purpose: the survey goes back to whatever channel the merchant already used, so no channel id is hard-coded here. Retries 3x — SIMS records only one csat_link_shared row per ticket, so a retry cannot fan out into duplicate history.
